extraction.title: Crunchtime in commodities
extraction.subtitle: Oil markets are still in La La land Prices have risen sharply. Unfortunately, they still have further to go
extraction.summary: The ongoing war in Iran has led to a significant oil supply shock, with Brent crude prices spiking above $125. Despite this, traders expect prices to fall, indicating a disconnect with the reality of supply shortages. The situation is complicated by geopolitical tensions and the potential for further disruptions in oil supply, particularly through the Strait of Hormuz.
